def evolved_pp_send_recv(activations, src_stage, half, M, rank, world_size,
                         num_devices, cores_per_device, xm, torch, num_nodes=1):
    """collective_permute: direct send/recv from src_stage ranks to paired dst ranks."""
    stage = 0 if rank < half else 1
    buf = torch.stack(activations, dim=0)
    if src_stage == 0:
        pairs = [[i, i + half] for i in range(half)]
    else:
        pairs = [[i + half, i] for i in range(half)]
    recv = xm.collective_permute(buf, pairs)
    out = buf if stage == src_stage else recv
    return [out[m] for m in range(M)]
